name: cloche
description: Cloche puts web apps you build in ChatGPT online, each at its own link, and lets you control who can open them. Use it to publish an app, share it, and send updates live to the same link.

interface.longDescription:
Cloche puts the apps you build in chat online. Ask for an app, and when it works, ask Cloche to publish it. You get a link that works outside the chat.

You decide who gets in: keep an app private, invite people by email, share a link that can expire, or make it public. You can also see who has access and take it back.

Ask for a change in any chat and it goes live at the same link. Cloche keeps every version, so you can put an earlier one back.

From the chat, Cloche can:
- Publish a new app or update one you already have
- Tell you whether an app is live, or why it failed
- Share an app, list who can open it, and take access back
- List your apps and delete one you no longer need
- Save unfinished work so another chat can pick it up

You sign in to Cloche in your browser the first time you connect.
defaultPrompt: Put the app we just built online with Cloche and give me the link.
List my Cloche apps and tell me which ones are shared.
